purpose: Is the PE-overlap guard's refusal on sub-floor tails caused by junction ambiguity (TruSeq R1/R2 share a 13 bp 5' prefix) or by readthrough_is_adapter re-imposing min_overlap_se=14? Custom 31 bp adapters A1/A2 share no prefix, so the insert junction is unambiguous.
note: --adapter-preset was illumina in the shared runner; the custom tails are checked by the detector (mate geometry) and by readthrough_is_adapter against the configured set. See docs/optim/raw/round2/fastprep-undertrim.md M1.
verdict: CONFONDED NEGATIVE CONTROL, not a mechanism test: run_paired hardcodes --adapter-preset illumina, so the custom A1/A2 tails were never in the configured set and readthrough_is_adapter must refuse them regardless of the floor. Kept for the record; see undertrim-probe-pe-guard.json for the decisive test.
